msg: hi! I've never dived before but I want to get my PADI certification while I'm in Cartagena. I'm here from the 20th to the 25th. how long does it take?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. So happy to have you here! I'd love to help you put your plan together. 🌊

Hi! Getting your first PADI certification is a great way to explore the Rosario Islands. The PADI Open Water course takes *2 days*, and you’ll need to stay overnight on the islands; accommodation isn’t included. The online theory takes about *10–12 hours* and must be completed before the practical sessions.

The course is *$693 USD online*. You’re here from the 20th to the 25th, so you have time to plan it—just remember to wait at least *18 hours after diving before flying*. Would you like the booking link?

msg: nice. which hotel do you recommend for the night on the island? is it included or do I book it myself?
reply:
For convenience, our dive base is at *Hotel San Pedro de Majagua* and *Hotel Cocoliso* on Isla Grande, so staying at either makes pickup straightforward. Other nearby options with maritime access include Rosario de Mar, Secreto, Ubuntu, Mulata, Eco Hotel Las Palmeras, and Pao Pao.

If you’re staying on the islands, pickup and return are at your hotel if it has maritime access.

Accommodation isn’t included in the course—you’ll need to book directly with the hotel. Would you like to continue with the Open Water course booking?

msg: yes! I'd do it on the 21st and 22nd. I'm from the US, just me. how do I pay?
reply:
Perfect! Since you’re new to diving, the *PADI Open Water course* is the right certification course. It takes 2 days, and you’ll need to stay overnight on the Rosario Islands; accommodation isn’t included.

The online price is *$693 USD*. You pay by card through the booking page, where you can select your dates and complete the booking:  
https://book.divingplanet.org/book/basic-course/4?language=en

Anyone who is not Colombian or a resident of Colombia (without a Colombian ID) pays in USD by card on the website; the rate is the same, only the currency changes.

Please note that the course includes diving on both days, so you’ll need to wait at least *18 hours after your final dive before flying*. Would you like help with anything else about the course?
